name: Paddock record keeper
design: Very slim old female Yautja, ivory and lavender-grey mottling, wide brow, four fine mandibles distinctly encircling separate small inner mouth, long silver-black scalp tendrils with simple woven cuffs. Olive long robe cut to mid-calf with short fitted leather work vest and narrow dusty-red belt. Holds a small unlettered bronze record slate against chest and an unmarked seal stylus down at side. Light civilian silhouette, clawed feet clear.
